name: ricky-pixel-mod
description: Ricky, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code: an animated night-sky pane with a task / subagent / activity / files board, a cat in the band above the prompt, and a purple-gold spinner

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of Ricky's words: "en" (English, default) or "zh" (简体中文).

bandSize.title: Band size
bandSize.description: Ricky above the prompt. "auto" (default): the biggest that fits — 24px, 16px, or just the 8px head. "large" / "medium" / "small": cap it at 24 / 16 / 8 px (it still steps down when there is no room). "off": no band.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Text colours of the dashboard. "auto" (default): follow Claude Code's theme — dark themes get brighter colours; with "Auto (match terminal)" it asks macOS. "light" / "dark": always use the colours for a light / dark background.
